description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component within the OpenClawKit project. It tests WebSocket connection handling, authentication token processing, URL normalization, and event stream behaviors, specifically targeting the GatewayNodeSession class and its interactions with WebSocket sessions and related token stores.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking used for testing WebSocket interactions within GatewayNodeSessionTests.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketSessioning used to simulate WebSocket sessions, including task creation and message handling for testing GatewayNodeSession.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor used to detect if a 'seqGap' event was received during tests, facilitating asynchronous event detection.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSessionTests
classes.description: A test suite for GatewayNodeSession, containing multiple test cases to verify connection, token handling, URL normalization, timeout behavior, and event streaming.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Tests that during connection setup, bootstrap token overrides stored device tokens.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Verifies that additional device tokens included in the bootstrap hello are stored correctly.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Checks that in non-bootstrap scenarios, primary device tokens are stored while bootstrap handoff tokens are not.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap tokens from untrusted sources are not persisted.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Test that URL normalization preserves explicitly specified secure port.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Test that URL normalization correctly backfills the gateway host for loopback URLs.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that invokeWithTimeout correctly returns responses before the timeout period.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Checks that invokeWithTimeout returns a timeout error when the invocation exceeds the specified timeout.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Ensures that setting timeoutMs to zero disables the timeout behavior.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Verifies that a synthetic 'seqGap' event is emitted following a reconnect snapshot, indicating gap in sequence numbers.
